Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks rebound as tech rally gains momentum on easing oil, yields
Markets.summary: US stocks rebounded sharply on Thursday, led by a technology-driven rally as oil prices and Treasury yields eased. The Nasdaq gained 1.66%, the S&P 500 rose 1.14%, and the Dow added 0.61% despite ongoing inflation and interest rate concerns.

Markets.title: US Treasuries rally as oil cools and confidence in Fed’s Warsh grows
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields fell and prices rallied as oil prices declined. This drop was also driven by growing investor confidence in the Federal Reserve's handling of inflation.

Markets.title: US mortgage rates brush 7%, weighing on buyers, sellers and further straining a bleak housing market
Markets.summary: US mortgage rates climbed to 6.95%, reaching their highest level since January 2025. This increase in borrowing costs is squeezing affordability, delaying purchases, and straining the housing market.

Markets.title: SEC gives tokenized stock trading platforms five-year regulatory relief
Markets.summary: The US SEC granted a five-year regulatory exemption to platforms that offer tokenized stock trading. This move allows these blockchain-based platforms to introduce 24/7 trading, instant settlements, and fractional ownership while maintaining investor protections.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian equities ended mixed on Thursday, with the Sensex slipping 22 points while the Nifty gained 53 points. Mid- and small-cap stocks outperformed, driven by buying interest in capital goods, industrial, defence, power, and healthcare sectors.

Markets.title: Sebi bars Kore Digital promoters over alleged Rs 541 crore revenue misstatement
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi has barred Kore Digital and three key executives from the securities market over alleged financial misstatements and the diversion of funds. Sebi also blocked the company's main-board migration and ordered a forensic audit of its records.

Geo-Political.title: Canada welcomes EU proposal to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney welcomed a European Union proposal for Canada to become an associate member. Carney stated that this alliance between Canada and the EU would create a beacon for other democracies.

Geo-Political.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
Geo-Political.summary: South African police found the body of a ninth woman, bringing an escalating string of deaths under investigation. Police cautioned against assuming the killings are connected, while local women remain fearful.

Geo-Political.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
Geo-Political.summary: UN experts state there are grounds to believe the United States committed war crimes during February strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd. The U.S. government has not acknowledged carrying out these deadly attacks in Iran.

Geo-Political.title: US to allow Iran delegation to attend UN meetings in New York as war passes half-year mark
Geo-Political.summary: The US is granting entry to an Iranian delegation, including President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, to attend UN meetings in New York. This diplomatic development coincides with the war passing its half-year mark.

Geo-Political.title: Wife of US scholar jailed in China asks Trump to raise arrest at Xi meeting
Geo-Political.summary: Sylvia Zin and other family members of individuals imprisoned in China are asking President Trump to raise these arrests with China's leader during their upcoming meeting next week. Zin is specifically seeking Trump's help to secure the release of her husband, a US scholar currently jailed in China.

Geo-Political.title: Hyrox athlete apologises for continuing race after soiling herself
Geo-Political.summary: Hyrox athlete Joanna Wietrzyk has apologized for continuing to race after soiling herself during a fitness competition last week. She has also forfeited her victory in the event.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author tested AI-driven traffic strategies by asking ChatGPT to recommend a SaaS course. The AI recommended the author's course as the top result without any paid advertising.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These applications help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that automate tasks and boost workflow efficiency across industries. These advanced, widely used applications are designed to increase overall productivity for a variety of uses.

Data & Insights.title: Centre to hold state finance ministers’ conference ahead of GST Council meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The Centre is hosting a conference of state finance ministers titled “Financing India’s Journey towards Viksit Bharat.” The event precedes the October 7 GST Council meeting and the start of pre-budget meetings for Union Budget 2027-28 on October 12.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi turns 76: Demonetisation, GST, PLI, Jan Dhan and more – Key economic policies rolled out since 2014
Data & Insights.summary: Since taking office in May 2014, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has implemented major economic reforms, including demonetisation, GST, and the PLI scheme. His administration has also driven welfare expansion, technological transformation, national-security shifts, and policy changes.

Data & Insights.title: Exclusive | Big change soon in how people earn, invest as salaried white-collar jobs set to decline: Saurabh Mukherjea
Data & Insights.summary: Saurabh Mukherjea warns that artificial intelligence will soon automate repetitive white-collar jobs and reshape the employment landscape. This shift is expected to decrease traditional salaried positions while promoting a rise in gig work, particularly in India.

Data & Insights.title: India’s US Treasury purchases surge to $15.2 billion in July, highest holdings in 10 months
Data & Insights.summary: India purchased $15.2 billion in US Treasuries in July, reaching its highest holdings in 10 months. This increase was driven by large inflows from the central bank's special facilities designed to attract overseas capital.

Data & Insights.title: India flags impact on ties, energy markets from US law on Russian oil imports
Data & Insights.summary: The US House passed a sanctions bill allowing up to 100% tariffs on countries like India and China for buying Russian energy. India warned this legislation could harm bilateral relations and energy markets.

Data & Insights.title: In charts: How India’s Russian oil imports shifted amid US tariff flip-flops
Data & Insights.summary: India faces potential 100% US tariffs under new legislation targeting buyers of Russian energy. This threat complicates India's ongoing efforts to diversify its energy security as its reliance on Russian oil surges.

India.title: 17-Year-Old Raped, Stabbed To Death In Delhi
India.summary: A 17-year-old girl in Delhi was sexually assaulted and stabbed to death by acquaintances after drinking with them inside a tempo. Police reported that the accused individuals subsequently disposed of her body.

India.title: 6-Month-Old Critical After Pit Bull Attack In Haryana's Sonipat, CCTV Captures Horror
India.summary: A six-month-old baby is in critical condition after being attacked and dragged by a pit bull in Sonipat, Haryana. CCTV footage captured bystanders attempting to rescue the child as the dog refused to let go.

India.title: Call For 9% Sub-Quota For Bhils Out Of ST Share, High Court Issues Notices
India.summary: The Rajasthan High Court issued notices regarding a petition demanding a 9% sub-quota for the Bhil community within the existing Scheduled Tribe reservation. Petitioners argued that the Meena community has unfairly received the majority of reservation benefits, leaving the Bhils inadequately represented.

India.title: PM Modi's Teacher Recalls Sharp Memory, Courage, And A Baby Crocodile
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi's former science teacher, HC Patel, recalled Modi's sharp memory and courage during his school years at Vadnagar. Patel also shared a story about Modi once bringing a baby crocodile to school.

India.title: Tata Sons' Trust Issue: Two-Pronged Row Goes Beyond The Chair
India.summary: Tata Sons faces a two-pronged conflict concerning N Chandrasekaran's continuation as executive chairman. The controversy also involves at least one additional unspecified issue.

India.title: 2 Rajya Sabha Members Made Special Invitees To Joint Panel On FCRA Bill
India.summary: Two Rajya Sabha members have been appointed as special invitees to the joint parliamentary committee reviewing the FCRA Bill. Joint and select committees are formed to examine specific bills and conclude their work after submitting a report.

General.title: Remains found after wildfire identified as mother-of-three missing since 2019
General.summary: The remains of Joanne Sheen, a mother-of-three missing since 2019, were found following a wildfire in London. A 56-year-old man has been arrested in connection with the case.

General.title: Charles 'sounded giddily elated' after Diana died, Earl Spencer claims
General.summary: Earl Spencer claims in a new book that then-Prince Charles sounded "giddily elated" after Princess Diana died. Buckingham Palace has strongly pushed back against these claims.

General.title: Interest rates held but Bank signals rise if energy prices stay high
General.summary: The Bank of England has kept interest rates on hold for the sixth consecutive time. However, the Bank warned that sustained high energy prices make a future rate increase more likely.

General.title: Father's tribute to 'sweetest little boy' Noah Woods
General.summary: Rhys Woods has paid tribute to his three-year-old son, Noah Woods, following the boy's death. He also expressed his deepest gratitude to the local community for their support.

General.title: King Charles warns of 'existential danger' of AI falling into wrong hands
General.summary: King Charles warned about the existential danger of artificial intelligence falling into the wrong hands during a Scottish summit. The event included participants from major AI companies such as Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic.

General.title: Archbishop of Canterbury withdraws award from Muslim cleric who praised Osama bin Laden
General.summary: The Archbishop of Canterbury has withdrawn an award given to a Muslim cleric last week. The cleric had previously praised Osama bin Laden.
